page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance within the ecs.gn5 family. Powered by an x86_64 CPU architecture on a KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs with 60.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a resource ratio of 7.5 GB per virtual CPU core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by two bundled NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a combined 32 GB of GPU VRAM. Local storage capabilities include 944 GB of integrated SSD storage to handle high-throughput disk access directly on the host, complemented by a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth specification.

The combination of dual discrete GPU accelerators, substantial system memory, local SSD capacity, and dedicated compute cores makes this configuration suitable for data-intensive parallel workloads. Primary application fits include deep learning training, AI inference execution, scientific simulations, complex graphics rendering, and heavy data analytics.
